The Gunners coasted past Everton last weekend to move level on points with Manchester City, who had earlier slipped up at Aston Villa. They do have a dreadful record at Anfield, though, and Mikel Arteta will be looking to put that right.

On the severity of Bukayo Saka's issue: "He needed another scan to see the amount and if the tendon was touched and how badly it was touched and afterwards, we will know more about it." He added that they will "have to wait and see next week", on Saka's availability for England duty. On Declan Rice, Riccardo Calafiori and Christos Tzolis: "They all trained today, they will train tomorrow and if everything is OK then they will be available."
